body:
## Quick answer

You can buy Indian clothes online from **Bahe Kurtiz** in Jaipur and have them delivered to Malaysia with **free express shipping and duties included** – nothing extra to pay on delivery. Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and arrive about 5–10 business days later; every style can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost.

## Sizes in Malaysia

Malaysian shops use mixed size systems. Compare your bust in inches with our size chart or use the [size converter](/tools/indian-size-converter/) – or choose free custom fit.

## What to wear in Malaysia

It is hot and humid all year, so choose breathable cotton, kota doria and lined chiffon or georgette, with three-quarter sleeves and looser fits.

## Festivals and wedding season

Deepavali is a public holiday in most of Malaysia, and Thaipusam is celebrated in several states – both are busy times for the Tamil and wider Indian community. See the exact last order dates for upcoming festivals below and on our [festival calendar](/festival/).

faq.q: How long does delivery to Malaysia take?
faq.a: Ready sizes are dispatched in 7–10 working days and custom-fit pieces in 10–15 working days; express delivery then takes about 5–10 business days, with tracking.

faq.q: Will I pay customs duty in Malaysia?
faq.a: No. We ship duties-paid (DDP), so duties and taxes are included and there is nothing to pay on delivery.

faq.q: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.a: Prices are in US dollars. Your card or PayPal is charged in USD and your bank converts it to ringgit.

faq.q: What if my size is not standard?
faq.a: Choose free custom fit and send your bust, waist, hip and height – we stitch the outfit to your measurements at no extra cost, up to size 3XL (4XL in our linen & velvet styles).
